headline: 14+ contracts catalogued across 12 chains; deployment docs identified but access-restricted; 9+ audits sourced from GitHub

findings.text: CoinGecko lists RIVER token (0xda7ad9dea9397cffddae2f8a052b82f1484252b3); block explorer enumeration incomplete due to access restrictions on app.river.inc

Contract roles identified: satUSD (token), SatoshiXApp/CoreFacet (core logic), BorrowerOperationsFacet (minting), FactoryFacet (factory), LiquidationFacet (liquidation), PriceFeedAggregatorFacet (oracle), StabilityPoolFacet (stability), NexusYieldManagerFacet (yield)

rationale.verdict: Discovery phase enumerated contract instances across multiple chains from docs and audit sources. Access restrictions on primary deployment docs and app domain prevented exhaustive per-chain enumeration. Addresses from CoinGecko, search-result previews, and audit repository structure are recorded. Next assessment will inherit these as pre-built surfacers and can perform deeper per-chain reads via block explorers and DeFiPunkd API.

protocol_metadata.about: River (formerly Satoshi Protocol) is an omni-chain stablecoin and liquidity system built on LayerZero OFT standard. It enables users to deposit BTC, ETH, BNB, or LSTs as collateral on one chain and natively mint satUSD stablecoin on another chain without bridges or wrapping. The protocol features isolated lending pools with liquidation management, stability mechanisms, and yield infrastructure through satUSD+ liquid staking token.
